positive_snippets: Very good location and service front office staffs behavior is very Good.

Really nice hotel. Aside from the numerous trip hazards on the way to the room, this is a solid 3 star hotel. Clean, spacious and in a great location.

One suggestion, the rooms need warmer lighting, especially the ones without a window. You end up with either bright white light or complete darkness.

Other than that, it’s a great place to stay. The staff are friendly and helpful.
